subject: Quick favor tip
text: No rush on the ticket, but if you need me to nudge the vendor, I can probably ping them after standup without stepping on your toes. Just send the order number and one line about why it matters, because folks move faster when the ask is plain. Also, if the update slips, I can flag it as a nice-to-have rather than a blocker. That keeps expectations light. Honestly, a quick reply from you saves me guessing, so don't sweat perfection—bullet points are fine. If it helps, I can copy you too, no problem.
